decisions.reason: The modular plant concept reports quantified customer savings of over 600,000 euros a year, which clearly exceeds aspiration levels and fits the firm's strategic direction toward modular solutions.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer and has its own dedicated web page, so it is an established line that a growing firm with slack has no reason to drop.
Evidence on this second modular concept is thin, but the firm is growing and has slack, and the concept aligns with its modular strategy, so problemistic search is not triggered yet.
The trommel screen is a natural complement to the firm's mobile processing portfolio and carries low risk, so keeping it is consistent with satisficing in good times.
